title: Microtubule-Stars: classical Kuramoto ring with holographic phase-pattern recall under a slow model drive (SYNTHETIC)
description:
SYNTHETIC. Standard-library Python classical Kuramoto simulation: a ring of phase oscillators stores phase-patterns as one interference record and recalls by projection. An optional slow multi-mode oscillation (stellar-pulsation-style model, not stellar data) modulates coupling gain. Measured: unstructured modulation degrades recall monotonically, with no 1:1 phase locking across scales. No quantum mechanics and no consciousness model are simulated; no claim of cosmic influence on brains.
